english.title: Drive a second taxi onto Heathrow Airport while another taxi driven by you remains on the Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) onto Heathrow Airport and, whilst that taxi remained on the airport, drove another taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), onto the airport
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9.11 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
